value.chatSnippet:
Direct Income Support
PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Financial / Equipment Benefit:
₹6,000 per year directly credited into farmer bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000.
Eligibility Criteria:
All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names. Aadhar-seeded active bank account and eKYC completed.
View Application Steps
Comprehensive Crop Insurance
PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
Financial / Equipment Benefit:
Comprehensive risk insurance covering yield losses due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, hailstorm, pests). Farmer pays only 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi.
Eligibility Criteria:
All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.
View Application Steps
Up to 60% Solar Subsidy
PM-KUSUM (Solar Agri Pump & Grid Subsidy)
Financial / Equipment Benefit:
Government subsidy of up to 60% for installing standalone solar agriculture pumps (3HP to 7.5HP) and solarizing existing grid-connected electric pumps.
Eligibility Criteria:
Farmers with agricultural land possessing an existing borewell/well requiring irrigation.
View Application Steps
Free Soil Nutrient Testing
Soil Health Card Scheme (National Mission)
Financial / Equipment Benefit:
Free periodic testing of 12 critical soil parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) with customized crop-specific fertilizer dosage prescriptions.
Eligibility Criteria:
All agricultural landholders in rural panch
